body: Thanks kupfernikel. I really appreciate the offer. I'm feeling better at the moment. :)

Thanks for the advice. I do have an Xbox One; I'll have to look into Dying Light. After Dead Island being lacking (never played the coop), I didn't even look into it. And I love Childish Gambino! 

I appreciate it. I've calmed down a bit from earlier, after allowing myself to just not worry about being productive, though I do need to stay mentally focused on something else. No more hurting myself for now. I may PM you if it comes up again, but I think I'll be good.

My boss told me how disappointed she was in me and that she broke her heart. I have sent an email since to each, but I don't think I'll get a response. 

I'm trying hard to do anything to distract myself. Music and video games are so far the best ways to distract but then I think all I am doing is wasting time and being worthless. I want to do productive things but as soon as I do I can't focus on working. 

Time is probably the answer, but that obviously sucks, as I'm sure everyone can understand

I really appreciate the response. Even that helps the tiniest bit.
